beats: Kael stands alone behind the bar, clutching the mysterious letter and staring at it in the dim light.
A heavy thud echoes as the front door swings open, and the traveller enters, drenched from the storm.
The traveller stands in the doorway, shaking her cloak and shivering as she faces the interior.
Kael peers over the bar, his hand instinctively hiding the letter as he eyes the newcomer.
The traveller approaches the bar, her boots clicking on the floorboards, her eyes fixed on Kael.
The two face each other across the warped wooden bar, the only light coming from the flickering oil lamps.
